replacements.Cada familia resuelve la integración de: Each family solves integration differently. Multimodal embedding and multimodal generation are not the same layer of the system.

replacements.Acceso dinámico a la imagen en toda la g: Dynamic access to the image throughout generation

replacements.Los modelos omni no son solo nativamente: Omni models are not only natively multimodal: they are designed for multimodal input and output under real latency constraints. Spoken conversation, simultaneous voice and text generation, and streaming processing impose qualitatively different architectural requirements from the three previous approaches.
replacements.Primer modelo omni de escala masiva con: First massive-scale omni model with text, audio, and image input and output. Trained end to end. It marks the transition from the VLM stage to the omni stage.
replacements.Diálogo hablado en tiempo real, gestión: Real-time spoken dialogue, interruption handling, and tool use during conversation. The native-audio and first-response-latency axis.
replacements.Comprensión y generación de texto, image: Streaming understanding and generation of text, image, audio, and video. It generates text and speech simultaneously with explicit temporal alignment during inference.

replacements.Sin benchmarks establecidos para calidad: No established benchmarks for real-time spoken-response quality
